test_cases.name: SAFE ELECTRICAL WORK
test_cases.text: Electrical maintenance was performed after the equipment was isolated, locked out and tagged. Zero energy was verified before the worker started the task.
test_cases.explanation: Model should recognize effective controls (isolation + lockout + zero energy verification)

test_cases.name: DANGEROUS ELECTRICAL EXPOSURE
test_cases.text: Worker entered an energized electrical area without completing lockout and isolation. The equipment remained energized while maintenance was being performed.
test_cases.expected_semantic: DANGEROUS / SIF YES / HIGH OR CRITICAL
test_cases.explanation: Model should identify: energized equipment, exposure, missing isolation, LOTO failure

test_cases.name: SAFE CONFINED SPACE PREPARATION
test_cases.text: The confined-space entry permit was approved before work. Atmospheric testing was completed, ventilation was established, and the rescue plan and trained attendant were confirmed.
test_cases.explanation: Must NOT interpret presence of 'confined space', 'atmospheric testing', 'rescue plan' as automatically dangerous

test_cases.name: DANGEROUS CONFINED SPACE ENTRY
test_cases.text: Worker entered a confined space without atmospheric testing or an approved permit. No trained attendant or rescue arrangement was available.
test_cases.expected_semantic: DANGEROUS / SIF YES / HIGH OR CRITICAL
test_cases.explanation: Should identify: confined-space entry, no atmospheric testing, permit failure, missing rescue controls

test_cases.name: SAFE WORKING AT HEIGHT
test_cases.text: Worker performed roof maintenance using inspected scaffolding, complete guardrails and an approved fall-arrest harness. The equipment was inspected before use.
test_cases.explanation: Must distinguish controlled work from fall exposure

test_cases.name: FALL PROTECTION FAILURE
test_cases.text: Worker performed roof work near an unprotected edge without a harness, guardrail or other fall protection system.
test_cases.expected_semantic: DANGEROUS / SIF YES / HIGH OR CRITICAL
test_cases.explanation: Should identify: working at height, unprotected edge, missing fall protection

test_cases.name: SAFE LIFTING OPERATION
test_cases.text: The lifting zone was barricaded and access was restricted. The crane was inspected and the load was secured before lifting. No person was permitted beneath the suspended load.
test_cases.explanation: Must not classify as dangerous simply because crane/lifting/suspended load appear in text

test_cases.name: LINE-OF-FIRE EXPOSURE
test_cases.text: A suspended load moved over an occupied work area while a worker remained directly underneath it. No exclusion zone or barricade was established.
test_cases.expected_semantic: DANGEROUS / SIF YES / HIGH OR CRITICAL
test_cases.explanation: Should identify: suspended load, worker underneath, exposure, missing exclusion zone/barrier

test_cases.name: AMBIGUOUS / INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION
test_cases.text: Electrical maintenance activity was observed in the work area. The report does not state whether the equipment was isolated or whether the worker was exposed to hazardous energy.
test_cases.explanation: Should recognize critical information is missing. Do not force YES or NO.

test_cases.name: SAFE REPORT WITH DANGEROUS-SOUNDING KEYWORDS
test_cases.text: Worker used PPE while performing routine electrical maintenance. The equipment was isolated before work, the permit was verified, all safeguards were checked, and no hazardous exposure occurred.
test_cases.explanation: MOST IMPORTANT: Must understand CONTEXT. Must NOT blindly classify as dangerous due to safety keywords.
